sourceReview: Not yet attested. The slice-selector traced every branch and helper reachable from weffects() through zhitu():4434 against zap.c, trap.c, display.c and pline.c, verifying each span with awk from the return-type line to the closing brace, and read the witness's recorded random-number log, screens, cursors and status lines rather than inferring them. The orchestrator independently confirmed four of its claims against the session file: recorded index 88 is the first bolt screen, 103 the first cloak-and-potion screen, 119 the last oil screen and 120 the first death screen; the status line reads HP:12(12) at steps 85, 88 and 103, so the hero loses no hit points inside the boundary; and step 88 carries five random-number values, so the fifteen screens are one ray iteration rather than fifteen. The attestation this field will hold is the worker's to earn and the orchestrator's to verify once every entry above is done, no-effect-yet, later or cannot-occur.
